harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built a site-to-site IPsec (IKEv2/PSK, strongSwan/swanctl) tunnel between OPNsense firewalls node1 and node2 over their shared transit network (10.255.255.0/30), carrying traffic between node3's private LAN (172.16.1.0/24, behind node1) and node4's private LAN (172.16.2.0/24, behind node2). Verified end-to-end reachability between node3 and node4 by private address while transit-link captures show only ESP traffic (no plaintext leakage). Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all four nodes, confirming boot-identity change and full recovery (interfaces, firewall rules, IPsec SA re-establishment, and end-to-end connectivity) after each restart.
actions_performed: Discovered topology via tcpdump/ARP/STP-bridge-id probing: node1/node2 vtnet0=management(exec), vtnet1=transit-to-peer, vtnet2=private-LAN-to-node3/node4 (both were admin-down, had to ifconfig up first)
Assigned OPNsense interfaces: node1 opt1=TRANSIT 10.255.255.1/30 (vtnet1), opt2=LANA 172.16.1.1/24 (vtnet2); node2 opt1=TRANSIT 10.255.255.2/30 (vtnet1), opt2=LANB 172.16.2.1/24 (vtnet2)
Generated PSK on node1 via openssl and transferred to node2 using secret_env (not embedded literally in any command)

Built swanctl-based IPsec config (IKEv2, PSK) via config.xml XML surgery: Connections/locals/remotes/children on both firewalls with local_ts/remote_ts=172.16.1.0/24<->172.16.2.0/24, validated via run_validations.php before applying
Fixed missing legacy <ipsec><enable/></ipsec> root flag (required for swanctl.conf generation) and corrected preSharedKey field names (keyType/Key not Type/secret) after inspecting IPsec.xml model

Added firewall pass rules for IKE/ESP on the transit (opt1) interface and for decrypted tunnel traffic via an assigned enc0 (opt3) interface, since OPNsense's automatic IPsec filter-rule generation only covers legacy phase1/phase2 config, not swanctl

Addressed node3 eth1 (172.16.1.10/24) and node4 eth1 (172.16.2.10/24) with static routes to the opposite private subnet via their firewall's LAN IP; made this persistent with RHEL7 ifcfg-eth1/route-eth1 files after discovering the initial `ip addr add` did not survive reboot

Verified IKE_SA ESTABLISHED / CHILD_SA INSTALLED on both firewalls, bidirectional ping between 172.16.1.10 and 172.16.2.10, and confirmed via tcpdump on the transit link that only ESP packets (no plaintext ICMP/private addresses) cross the wire

Executed the mandatory restart protocol: captured boot-identity + IPsec/interface health baseline on all 4 nodes, restarted node1, node2, node3, node4 one at a time (native reboot/shutdown -r, backgrounded so ack returned first), polled each until reachable, confirmed changed boot markers (kern.boottime for OPNsense, /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id for RHEL7), and verified full recovery (interfaces, firewall, IPsec SA, end-to-end ping) after each before proceeding to the next
Cleaned up temporary scratch files (test IPs, tcpdump captures, PSK file, reboot logs) on all nodes

evidence.requirement: IPsec tunnel established between node1 and node2 over transit network
evidence.summary: swanctl --list-sas on both firewalls shows IKE_SA ESTABLISHED (IKEv2) and CHILD_SA INSTALLED (TUNNEL, ESP:AES_GCM_16-128) between 10.255.255.1 and 10.255.255.2, local/remote traffic selectors 172.16.1.0/24 <-> 172.16.2.0/24

evidence.requirement: node3 and node4 reach each other by private address with traffic encrypted in transit
evidence.summary: Bidirectional ping succeeds between node3 (172.16.1.10) and node4 (172.16.2.10, 0% loss); simultaneous tcpdump on node1's transit interface (vtnet1) during the ping shows only ESP packets between 10.255.255.1/.2, confirming encryption in transit with no plaintext leakage

evidence.requirement: node1 baseline health and restart with recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline kern.boottime=17:13:17 and established SA captured; reboot acknowledged and node became unreachable then reachable again with kern.boottime=17:29:21 (changed); post-restart shows interfaces up, firewall rules restored, IPsec SA re-ESTABLISHED, and node3->node4 ping succeeds

evidence.requirement: node2 baseline health and restart with recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline kern.boottime=17:13:17 captured; reboot acknowledged, node unreachable then reachable with kern.boottime=17:30:00 (changed); post-restart IPsec SA re-ESTABLISHED and node4->node3 ping succeeds

evidence.requirement: node3 baseline health and restart with recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id=3dba43a5-... captured; reboot acknowledged, node unreachable then reachable with new boot_id=74193578-... (changed); private IP/route were not persistent after reboot (fixed with ifcfg-eth1/route-eth1), then node3->node4 ping succeeds confirming recovery

evidence.requirement: node4 baseline health and restart with recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id=b35fad86-... captured; reboot acknowledged, node unreachable then reachable with new boot_id=5af86a28-... (changed); post-restart shows persistent ifcfg-eth1 IP/route intact and node3->node4 ping succeeds confirming full recovery
